preconditions.description: The number of pastures, n, is between 2 and 100,000, inclusive.
The number of paths, m, is between 1 and 300,000, inclusive.
Each pasture is identified by a unique integer between 1 and n, inclusive.
No pasture is connected to itself.
The length of each path, li, is between 1 and 10^9, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output for each path i is either -1 (indicating no sunny paving is possible) or a non-negative integer representing the minimum possible length of the longest path in a sunny paving using only the first i paths.

invariants.expression: all(output[i] <= output[j] for i < j if output[i] != -1 and output[j] != -1)
invariants.description: If a sunny paving is possible after adding the first i paths and the first j paths (with i < j), then the minimum possible length of the longest path in a sunny paving after adding the first i paths is less than or equal to the minimum possible length of the longest path in a sunny paving after adding the first j paths.
